description:
Ah, the kitchen. This is some kind of kitchen, really great standard vibes in this place, a wonderful standard atmosphere. And now, well, you're in it. Let's see what's in here.

You can see a closed fridge. You see a closed oven. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a table. You see a cookbook on the table. Now that's what I call TextWorld!
